reviewer: Editorial source review assisted by Codex
scope: Five existing vehicle dossiers: AT-AT, AT-ST, Snowspeeder, Imperial Speeder Bike and Sand Crawler. All fifty inherited fields assessed, fifteen verified/corrected and thirty-five unestablished; sixteen new scoped facts and thirty-two checked links. Heights/lengths, ground/atmospheric speed, nominal crew/actual riders and type/variant boundaries preserved. No new identities, episode rows, dates, editions or credits.

records.scope: First scoped review of this existing vehicle dossier: all ten inherited fields assessed, original short description, selected type/technical facts and individually cited work/place/operator links. Not a complete variant, hull, edition or appearance inventory.
limitations: The current Databank gives a nominal HEIGHT of 22.5 m. This becomes a new height field with explicit metres; it does not verify the inherited length 20. Early Seelos models and other variants do not automatically share this dimension.

The article supports up to forty troops depending on internal configuration. The inherited bare 40 is qualified rather than treated as every configuration’s guaranteed passenger capacity. No five-person crew, 60 speed, manufacturer, cargo mass or cost is inferred.

The Force Awakens connection is a toppled habitation/wreck, not active combat. Rey is its resident, not thereby a pilot. The named Hellhound Two/Interrogator context does not create new hull records. The Mandalorian and Grogu own-list entry supplies selected work-level identity, not a full scene/variant review.

All ten inherited fields are assessed individually. A nominal published dimension is not a measurement of every variant or named hull. Height, length and ground speed are different quantities; no image scale, toy measurement or model analogy supplies an unsupported number.

Unknown/none is not zero or biological/mechanical absence. A two-person normal crew or an actual shared ride does not certify a universal maximum passenger limit. Unsupported raw values and original source IDs remain recoverable while published values are withheld.

Only selected work/place/operator/lineage links are reviewed, not a complete frame, edition, episode or credit inventory. Existing incoming and episode evidence remains unchanged. New dates, identities, editions and credits are outside this batch; original-USA release research scope retained.

limitations: The current published nominal LENGTH is 40 m, replacing the inherited 36.8 with trailing whitespace. Treaded/track-based description corrects the old wheeled classification without inventing a precise chassis model.

The old Digger Crawler model and Corellia Mining Corporation attribution are not stated in the selected references. Neither are 150000 credits, 30 speed, 46 crew, 30 passengers, 50000 cargo mass or two months of consumables.

Jawas are named users, but this batch adds no new Jawa person/species identity. The Tatooine activity and the Mandalorian episode’s crawler are selected contexts, not one named hull or a claim that all crawlers operate on Tatooine.

The own work list supports A New Hope, The Phantom Menace and Attack of the Clones. The Mandalorian is separately established by its actual Chapter 2 captions despite omission from that list. The Book of Boba Fett remains outside the current production intake; omitted links do not establish absence.

All ten inherited fields are assessed individually. A nominal published dimension is not a measurement of every variant or named hull. Height, length and ground speed are different quantities; no image scale, toy measurement or model analogy supplies an unsupported number.

Unknown/none is not zero or biological/mechanical absence. A two-person normal crew or an actual shared ride does not certify a universal maximum passenger limit. Unsupported raw values and original source IDs remain recoverable while published values are withheld.

Only selected work/place/operator/lineage links are reviewed, not a complete frame, edition, episode or credit inventory. Existing incoming and episode evidence remains unchanged. New dates, identities, editions and credits are outside this batch; original-USA release research scope retained.
